sectionSubtitle: We built Arkaleo thoughtfully so you can focus only on what matters: your ideas.

features.title: Encrypted Privacy
features.description: Your notes and attachments are locally end-to-end encrypted. We never see your data, ever.

features.title: Hand-written Sketches
features.description: A robust digital canvas lets you draw, sketch, and map out concepts natively on your screen.

features.title: Rich Text & Markdown
features.description: Powerful markdown editor with flexible typography, bringing desktop-grade focus to mobile.

features.title: Offline-First Engine
features.description: No internet? No problem. Everything works 100% offline with zero lag or syncing bottlenecks.

features.title: Dynamic Themes
features.description: Choose your vibe with our dynamic/custom colors, like our beautiful Liquid Glass Theme.

features.title: Multi-Language
features.description: Use the app seamlessly in your preferred regional language spanning across India and beyond.
